balls.text: short delivery just outside off, and Stubbs swivels and mistimes a pull towards long-on. The batters still pinch two even as the ball went off the higher side of the bat
wow, a short ball at 147kph hurries on to Nigam! The batter is standing just outside leg, and can only fend this off his glove down the leg side

Dhoni fumbles in collecting the ball, but there's no bye there! Short delivery from Pathirana, as the ball shapes back in to finish on leg and cramp Nigam for room, with the latter looking to ramp but missing

run-out first ball! When it's Jadeja, you know exactly where and at what speed the throw will be coming. Ashutosh is nowhere in the frame as Dhoni collects the ball before whipping the stumps off. Pathirana welcomed Ashutosh with an inswining batter which arrived on leg. Ashutosh could only clip it towards square leg, where Jadeja rushed forward from the boundary. There was a mix-up between the batters regarding the possible second, and eventually Ashutosh fell well short

gone! Gloved behind to Dhoni! He took it with a reverse cup in front of his face while moving to his left. A bouncer from Pathirana, who banged the ball in short on the stumps. It arrived almost close to Rahul's face, as he looked to hook it by slightly getting across. But he could only get a glove for a simple catch for Dhoni
on the fuller side, and around fifth stump. Stubbs has a hoick across the line but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat to deep-backward square leg
swings this in, and ends up bowling wide of leg. Again Dhoni couldn't collect cleanly, and the batters got a single

very full, as he angles this across, and goes wide of off. Stubbs shaped to reverse scoop but missed. But with nothing to lose, DC review hoping for a wide. Stubbs was across the stumps there, and the ball passes "well inside the revised wide line", says the third umpire. So DC lose a review

Gaikwad overruns from long-off... and misses the ball! He went for the catch rather than saving the runs, and the ball dropped just in front of him as he ran forward. It was another full toss, albeit a low one, around off, as Stubbs lifted it down the ground
cracked down the ground! Short of a length, and just outside off, as Stubbs, from deep in the crease, and with his front leg out of the way, sends the ball flying off the bat

dropped by Choudhary! It was a dolly, and even Dhoni seems to be wondering what happened there. The ball came to Choudahry's right, but he never got close to the ball, which dropped off his hands. It was another full toss dipping around off, as Rahul mistimed his attempted swish across the line
Rahul misses out! This was angling across, and coming on as a full toss around sixth stump. He may have tried a bit too hard to try and loft, but missed

swept over the man at backward square leg! Rahul gets across his stumps, and exposes all of them, as he spots Choudhary going on a length, and wide outside off. Rahul reaches out, and gets four, though

good save by Gaikwad, who moves to his right from long-off, and barely manages to avoid touching the rope. Rahul lofted this near yorker-length delivery around off, and almost stood his ground. Did he assume that it was going for four? Who knows?
this time Pathirana goes on a fullish length, and around sixth stump. Driven to mid-off, as only five runs come in the over so far
slower ball from Pathirana, who bowls short and wide-ish of off. Rahul shapes to pull, but gets a bottom edge on the pitch. The slowness of the pitch came into play there
full and quick, and just outside off. Driven to extra cover's left
a full toss on his knees on middle, and Rahul can only swing it towards fine leg

direct hit would have been close! Ashwin, at extra cover, had a go at the non-striker's end, but the throw turned out to be wide. Stubbs drove this short-of-a-length ball outside off, and took off, taking a detour around the bowler to complete the run
short of a length again, and this pitches on middle and arrives around off. Punched to long-off

ohh, this would have landed in the stands had Rahul connected! Short of a length on the stumps from Khaleel, and Rahul looked to pull hard with his front leg out of the way. But he got a bottom edge on to his pad, and the ball rolled away to the off side
another shortish delivery, but this pitches on middle and finishes on off. Punched down the pitch for mid-off to cut it to his right

hooked to fine leg! Great placement there! A bouncer from Khaleel on middle and leg, and Stubbs swivels while also rolling his wrists to keep this on the ground, and to beat the straightish fine leg for four
good running! Short of a length on middle and off, an punched towards deep extra cover. Jadeja, at deep cover, chases to his right, and Stubbs and Rahul pinch two

taken by Jadeja! He was placed at deep cover, and had to run forward a good dew steps to take it in front of his stomach. Khaleel angled this across to Rizvi, and bowled on a fullish length in the channel just outside off. Rizvi was deep in the crease, and looked to loft, but the face of the bat seemingly didn't open enough for the shot. He even lost his bottom hand off the bat, as the ball ballooned up for Jadeja

attempts another reverse scoop, but this time gets an inside edge! His front leg finishes well wide of off as he looks to play that shot, and the ball ends up hitting it. Another one on the fuller side from Choudhary, who bowls outside off, and gets away with this
a loud groan from Rahul on missing this! Slower delivery, and on the fuller side of a length, just outside off. Rahul looked to slash, but missed

lovely reverse scoop! This is the first time ever that I'm seeing him play that shot! There was a short third in place, and Rahul found the gap between him and Dhoni by swinging off this fullish ball angling across and arriving around sixth stump
Rizvi is deep in the crease too, and he looks to get across the stumps pretty late. The ball is fullish and wide of off, and driven to deep cover
Rahul is standing deep in the crease, and across the stumps, as he swipes this fuller ball outside off to short fine leg. This one comes off the inside half of the bat
angling across, and on a length on middle. Rahul looks to launch at it, but gets it off the outside half of the bat to deep extra cover

into the CSK dugout! Where else to send it if you want to send a message?! The over is done, but Dhoni has a word with Noor immediately after that. Noor bowled this on a length and wide of off, and Rizvi read the dip and slowness of the ball to cream it over long-on for six
ahh, nearly chopped on! Quicker, and fullish on off, as he bowls flatter too. Rahul looks to tap it down, but gets a bottom edge just wide of off

swept to deep-backward square leg! Rahul is loving the sweep today! He gets his front leg out of the way, and reads this length ball pitching on off and turning in to find the gap between the fielders at fine leg and deep midwicket
fullish ball outside off, and quicker this time. Rizvi mistimes a pull to long-on
short in length around middle and off, and turning in. Pulled to deep midwicket

wow, flung away over the umpire's head! Noor angled it across, and went full and wide of off. Rahul reaches out - and the bottom hand comes off, too - but the ball is flat-batted for four down the ground

good stop by Dhoni tumbling to his right, as Chennai finds its voice again! Another short ball from Pathirana, although this one seemed to have come slower. It arrived on middle and off, and Rizvi was hit on his body as he looked to pull but missed, and the ball trickled away behind the stumps
thumped wide of long-on! He uses Pathirana's pace, and dispatches the ball for a boundary. Short delivery from Pathirana, who went just outside off. But Rizvi rode the bounce, and sent that away

ohh, the fine leg is very straight, and that gives Rahul a single, as he pulls this shortish ball pretty belatedly. The ball angled in to arrive at middle and leg, and Rahul chose to wait before pulling
a fullish delivery in the corridor outside off. He has a big heave at it to long-on, with the ball coming off the inside half of the bat
a near yorker just outside off, and Rahul whips it to long-on for his first fifty this season
slower delivery on the shorter side of a length, and slightly wide of off. He shaped to hoick, but eventually dabbed it towards point for a single
again Rahul comes down the track, and drives this length ball around sixth stump to the man at extra cover, who's right on the edge of the circle. Rahul wanted a single, but was sent back by Rizvi
short of a length on off, and punched to long-off
shorter side of a length, and wide of off. Left alone, and wide called
short of a length on leg. He looked to swipe, but was hit on his pad
on a length, and quicker on middle and off. Turns away a bit, and is punched to deep cover
gone... for six! Rahul skips down the pitch, and swings the bat in a full flurry for six over long-on! He picked this length ball dipping on off, and heaved freely
on a fullish length, and angling in to pitch on leg. Whipped to deep square leg
crunched wide of mid-off! Rahul is sitting deep in the crease, and drives forcefully at this length delivery around off. He presented the full face of the bat at that, and sent it away rocketing

good running! Pathirana bowled this on the shorter side of a length, and a bit wide of off. Rizvi looked to cut it away but got a bottom edge. And although the ball just about rolled off the pitch, they still got a single
another short and wide ball outside off. Rizvi reaches out to slash that wide of the man at extra cover, and the batters pinch two in quick time
short again, and this finishes around sixth stump after shaping away from just outside off. Rizvi swayed out of the way, meanwhile
short in length, and wide outside off. Rahul throws his bat at it to cut that to deep-backward point without any foot movement
a yorker, but it pitches wide outside leg. Rizvi goes deep in the crease and looks to flick, but the ball is too wide for him. Dhoni fumbles on the collection, and the batters get another single
bowls this on a short length while angling it in. It pitches on on middle and leg, and goes on with the angle. Rahul looked to clip but the ball hit his pad, and dribbled away
full and slower on middle and off. Rahul looked to push forward, but got an inside edge towards deep midwicket
full and dipping, and just outside off. Driven to long-off

bowled him! Axar looked to repeat what Rahul did earlier in the over, but he missed, and Noor has the expression of a hero. Noor bowled this on a fullish length, and got it to dip on a middle-and-off line. Axar, like Rahul, had got his front leg out of the way to try and heave this across the line. But this ball was slower, and hinted to turn in, before he missed and it struck the stumps
this is quicker from Noor, who bowls fuller and wider of off. Rahul drags it for a sweep to deep midwicket
bang! Dumped over the deep-midwicket boundary! He collapses his back knee, gets his front leg out of the way, and slog sweeps this length ball on the stumps for six
bowls a wide-ish yorker-length all outside off, and Axar drills it to deep cover point
Ashwin slows his action this time, only at the last second before delivering the loopy full ball on leg. It's flicked to deep midwicket
Rahul goes for the slog sweep, finds deep midwicket on the bounce. Was a 96ks length ball on middle stump, so the shot was riskier than it initially seemed
Wide and flat on a length, close to the off-side tramline. Very skiddy. Cut to deep point
Flat on a length, around off, worked back to the bowler
Works the length ball on the pads to long-on

Ashwin jumps wide of the crease just before the delivery stride and bowls a carrom ball that lands around fourth stump and spins in somehow. Rahul dances down while making room too and drives over the bowler's head. Finds long-off
Length around leg, Axar tries to flick it square. Misses, gets hit on the pad. Ball drops down onto the ground.

Edged cut goes through where first slip would've been. MS Dhoni took a step leg side and got upright, he couldn't reach to the other side and the ball sped away. Was a length ball around off to which Axar rocked back and committed to the shot despite being late on it.
Touch short, just outside off. Goes straight on and sits up, 96ks. Rahul pulls it across the line, clothes it, finds long-on on the bounce
Full on fourth, driven to long-off. 95ks, looked like the stock ball
Length on leg, flicked to the left of deep midwicket. The run is far enough for the batters to take two
Full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Looped up and Axar doesn't hold back with the cover drive. There were calls of catch but the ball hovered in the air only momentarily and raced well to the left of the fielder at the edge of the ring
Full at the stumps, 96ks, swept to deep midwicket.
Axar backs away and cuts a length ball on middle and leg like it was outside off, finds deep point
Full on off, driven back to the bowler
Back-foot punch takes the length ball on fourth to cover

Wonder if Ashwin saw Rahul shaping for the reverse. Might have, he went shortish and very quick. Line's just outside off, Rahul's hurried a touch but manages to connect with that reverse. Gets it along the ground through point
Axar pumps Jadeja over straight-long-on first ball. DC's skipper needs no sighters, sees the full ball just outside off and realises he could swing through the line.

Soft dismissal, Porel guides it to short third. Not something you see off a spinner, but trust Jadeja's pace to create these. Was a quickish length ball just outside off, skidded off the pitch, Porel wanted to use that pace and run the ball along the ground. The bat was behind him and the face was open, but the ball ballooned up and actually carried to short third. Almost like catching practice to pacers.
Length ball around leg, Rahul slides leg side - while in the crease - and drives to long-off
Length outside off, Rahul waits and late cuts. Finds short third
Porel tries to take Jadeja on. The 97kph ball around off wasn't that short but the batter rocked back and tried to power a pull. Didn't middle it, gets it to deep midwicket
Fullish around off, driven to long-off
Works the 95ks length ball on the pads to mid-on's left for a single

Wide release from Ashwin, Rahul starts dancing down but realises the shortish ball was following him and adjusted his shot. Ends up trying to flick it softly with a closed bat face, gets a leading edge that lands on the pitch and goes to the bowler
Full on the pads, Porel uses the angle to sweep to short fine leg
Length ball's around off stump, rises to three-fourth of the way up the stumps. Looked to have spun in, so it might've been an offbreak. Rahul backs away and drives to the left of mid-off
Turns it off a length softly towards square leg for a quick single
Cut between short third and backward point. All placement that. Good ball, length just outside off. Turning away from the leftie, got good bounce but Porel used it to chop it late
Quick single to mid-off. Was a three-quarter-length ball angling in towards top of off that was punched with a mostly full-faced bat
Touch back of a length over leg stump, 139ks, flicked softly to midwicket
This time Rahul backs away and cuts to deep point. Was a length ball that bounced just over off stump. Even bounce off the pitch

Pulled in front of square this time, not middled but Rahul was opening his hips and was trying to muscle it. Got it well to the left of Conway, who ran from deep square leg. Stops it with a slide close to the ropes. Wasn't all that short a ball, maybe a touch over stump-height, was at the stumps too

Khaleel misses his line and Rahul helps it around the corner. The length ball is at the thigh, Rahul stays in the crease for most of the ball's path and flicks it with a swivel of the hips. He knew short fine leg was in and could use the pace. Effectively a free hit
Length ball on top of fourth, jabbed with a fully open bat face to third
Pitched up, flicked towards mid-on

Great yorker. 143ks on off, well handled too. Porel doesn't move his feet, the upper body lunges and the hands drop. The bat lays with its toe pointing towards deep third, that's where the ball's directed
Works the length ball on leg to midwicket

KL goes big this time, pumps the full ball through the line. Straight of mid-on, clears the infield. One-bounce four. He crouched low, got the front foot out the way and drove it with a full follow-through
Whips the full ball on fourth to the left of long-on. Played along the ground
Rahul continues to work his way into the innings. Drives the fullish ball outside off to deep point
Punches the fullish ball back to the bowler
Length on leg, clipped to deep square leg
Backs away and carves the shortish ball to deep point
Shortish ball outside off, guided to deep backward point
Gets a length ball on the hips, flicked to deep square leg
Length around off, guided to deep-backward point
Length around off, worked to midwicket

This time, Porel connects with the upper cut over the slips, this isn't all that wide. Fourth-stump line, around chest-high, and Porel stays leg side of the ball and uses his bat like a ramp to elevate the ball

Dropped? Given as runs but Hawk-Eye shows the shortish ball was well away from the bat as Porel tried to ramp it over the keeper. The ball swung after passing the bat and Dhoni, who couldn't run, tried to reach out with his left hand. Couldn't get lay glove on it
Uses the pace this time and pulls it just behind square.
Whipped straight of mid-on, very wristy. Almost like Porel was playing spin. Was a full ball just outside off, big wind-up and follow-through. Not middled but hit very hard
A bit of away swing takes the length ball on fifth, pushed to point
Length on top of off, flicked to deep square leg. Rahul will have to wait for strike

Four short and one full, that's all you need. It's actually fuller side of length but JFM was starving to slug the ball off the front foot with an open stance. Saw the 137ks ball around off in his half and tried to clear mid-on. Safe option as only square leg was out, but the ball went off the bottom of the bat. It stayed high for a while, Ashwin walked back from the edge of the ring and reverse-cupped the catch
Shortish ball is straighter this time. At the body, JFM goes across to get behind the line and block it

Beaten comprehensively. Not sure what JFM wanted to do there. The hands followed the shortish ball on fifth - essentially the same ball as the first two - but this one fizzed off the pitch. In the end, it was a wipe of the bat, hoping to run it to third.
Beaten on the pull. Almost the same ball as the previous one, angling away outside off but JFM wanted to drag it across. All hands, no feet
Back of length on fifth, 137ks, square driven on top of the bounce. Finds point, who's close in
through Mukesh's hands! Another full toss perhaps in search of another yorker, as this swings to arrive outside off. Shankar pushes forward aerially, and the ball ends at long-off
another full toss - this one's around his knee - around off, and Dhoni hoicks towards deep midwicket
between point and short third! He threw his bat at this yorker wide-ish of off, and played without any foot movement. Four in the gap, for what it's worth in terms of NRR
perfect delivery! Mukesh lands another yorker just outside off, and Shankar digs it out to long-on
sliced over backward point! He opens the face of teh bat at this low full toss in the channel outside off, and bags two
pumped over the bowler's head! Shankar is deep in the crease, and he presents the full face of the bat at this length ball around seventh stump. First six for Shankar
another pinpoint yorker around sixth stump at 138kph. Dhoni jams his bat down, but misses
very full on off, and again only clipped to deep midwicket
on the shorter side of a length just outside off, and slapped towards cover
Starc hits back with another yorker! Swings in to land at the base of off, and Shankar manages to whip it to deep midwicket

a late ramp for four! Shankar almost withdrew his bat, and even took his eyes off, before sending it flying over the keeper's head. It was a bouncer climbing on middle, and Shankar played it as late as was possible
there comes the yorker, swinging in towards off at 143kph. Driven to deep cover point

five wides, and remember, there's still a crowd in Chennai! Starc angled this in from around the stumps, but went on a length and way wide of leg. Dhoni left it, and even a tumbling Rahul couldn't stop it
excellent stuff! Mukesh lands a yorker just outside off, and Dhoni squeezes it away to the bowler's left for a hurried single
very full, and in the corridor outside off. Dhoni drives it down towards long-off off the bottom of the bat, and they pinch two

bam! The ball lands miles into the crowd! But how much will this really matter from here? Mukesh went on a length, and slightly wide of off, as Dhoni, from deep in the crease, blasted it back down the ground
another low full toss around off from a DC quick, and Shankar drives it to long-on
short delivery pitching on middle, and finishing outside leg as he looked to pull but missed. Wide called
change of pace, and on a fullish length just outside off. Dhoni stands deep in the crease, and powerfully swings on the bounce to long-on
swings in, and lands on a length around sixth stump. Dragged to long-on off the inside half of the bat
slower, and on a length on the stumps. Punched to deep extra cover
backs away early, and Axar bowls on a good length, and flat outside off. Swatted back on the bounce to Axar
full and quicker on off, and pushed towards cover point
Shankar makes room... and can merely hoick this full and slow ball on middle to deep midwicket. He has got to his fifty, but there's hardly a reason to applaud
fuller ball on middle, and straightening. Whipped towards square leg
angled in from around the wicket, and on a length on the stumps. Clipped to deep square leg
superb stuff from Mohit! He keeps landing the ball on a yorker length - this one went on off - and Shankar can, once again, only heave to deep midwicket
on a short of a length on off, and clipped to short fine leg. They take a single, and nearly get a second after the overthrow
very full, and wide outside off. Dhoni leaves it alone, and it is called wide
another yorker around the sixth-stump line, and Dhoni can only drive to Axar at extra cover. Shankar wanted a single but was sent back
this lands right in the yorker zone, and just outside off. Dhoni can only manage to push it back to Mohit's right
almost a yorker on off, and Shankar can only swing it towards deep midwicket
slower delivery at 101kph, and fullish and wide of off. Shankar lets it go, and it is called wide
short of a length around off, as Mohit goes wide of the crease. Pulled to deep midwicket
a lofty punch! On a length around middle and off, and he made room early. He presented the full face of the bat at that, and punched with a high left elbow, to go over extra cover,
off the toe-end of the bat! Fuller and slower, and angling across towards off. He looked to heave, but mistimed it badly
on a length on middle and off. He looks to slash, but gets a bottom edge on to his pad
another boundary! Shankar hits four more! Short delivery on middle, and he shifts his weight back and gets his front leg out of the way to dispatch this
on a shortish length, and wide of off. Shankar slashes far away from his body, but can only place it just wide of the man at short third
ohh, full and slow, and dipping on leg stump. The ball turns away, and Shankar is hit somewhere close to his stomach as he looks to sweep but misses
short again, and just outside off. Mohit bowls this at only 110kph, and Shankar can pull it only towards deep midwicket
finally a boundary! The ball pierces the fielders at fine leg and deep midwicket, as Shankar pulls at this short-of-a-length delivery which seemed to have kept a little low
slower bouncer on a seventh-stump line. Dhoni waits for it come, before half-hooking towards deep midwicket
Mohit bangs it short, and just outside off, and Dhoni misses on an attempted pull. The ball went over Dhoni's head as he swung his bat and body. A bouncer from Mohit
a near yorker-length ball on sixth stump. Shankar lofts it from deep in the crease, and plays it wide of long-off. And it's a no-ball too, so free hit for none other than... Dhoni
a good-length ball floated just outside off, as Dhoni opens the face of the bat to jab to deep third
bowls short and just outside off. Pulled forcefully to deep-backward square leg
on the bounce to fine leg, where the man is placed only three-fourths of the way back. Much fuller and slower on leg, as Shankar swept it aerially
a dipping and very full ball on middle, and driven to long-off
dropped by Stubbs! He's usually a reliable fielder, though. Shankar pulled another short ball from Kuldeep, and even as Stubbs was moving and sliding forward, the ball popped out of his hands
ohh, lovely turn! On a length on off, and turning in to end on middle, as Dhoni aerially pushes down to long-off
the wrong 'un! Short in length, and pitching on middle but finishing outside off, as Shankar shifts his weight back to pull to long-on
tossed up, as this lands very full, and around sixth stump. A casual push to long-off by Dhoni
full and flat, and around sixth stump. He drives hard, but right to the man at extra cover
on the shorter side, and slightly wide of off. Slapped to deep cover
fuller ball on off, and pushed towards extra cover as Nigam bowls quicker
slower, and full and just outside off. He almost bends to nudge to back to Nigam's left
full and loopy, and just outside off. Dhoni drives it late to deep extra cover to pick two
short in length around middle and off, and turning away. Shankar goes down on his back knee, and pulls towards deep square leg
fuller ball, and on middle. Driven down to long-off
Kuldeep bowls on a length on middle, and turns it in sharply to finish outside leg. Whipped to fine leg after opening his stance up

a confident appeal by Rahul, and even before he's done, the umpire's finger is up! That tells you how plumb that was. It is the googly from Kuldeep, who tosses it up, and lands it full on middle and off. Jadeja looks to flick this from around off, but leaves a gap between bat and pad. The ball turns in to strike his front pad, and he's gone!
fuller side on middle and leg, and turns away. Clipped towards deep midwicket
good work by Starc, who moves to his left from long-off, and takes the ball on two bounces. Shankar opened the face of the bat, and lofted this fuller ball outside off
on a fullish length on middle and off, and clipped to deep-backward square

Top-edged sweep... has been dropped. Kuldeep was back-pedalling but wasn't running in a straight line, tried to take it above his shoulder while on the move. Don't think he touched it. Was a length ball angling in that Shankar tried to sweep, looked like he wanted to go aerial
Length on fourth, flicked to deep backward square leg
Chipped inside out, wide of cover. Goes to long-off. Was a fullish ball that was wide
Fullish ball looped up is wide, spins in a touch, Jadeja takes a big stride across and flicks it to long-on

Six and out, Dube holes out to long-on. The crowd, who had started roaring, have been silenced again. 89ks, not exactly off the top of the hand, but the line was wide. The length was full and Dube tried to drag it across with a slog sweep. Toed it right up, Stubbs runs in and takes a regulation catch
Lands it short and Dube whacks the pull over cow corner. It's the first six of the innings. Dube was happy to show all the stumps, cleared the front leg and hit it 86 metres far.
Quicker this time, 90ks, although it didn't look like it to the naked eye. Was a fullish ball on off that was punched to long-on
Pulled to deep midwicket while swirling the front foot around
Dube tries to manufacture pace but finds deep midwicket. Slowish ball was slightly short if at all and around fourth, big wind-up from Dube but didn't get much elevation
Similar ball, seems to have spun in more. Slow off the pitch, pulled to long leg
Touch short, slowish and at the stumps, pulled to the left of deep square leg
Looped up and Dube goes for the slog sweep, not middled and it goes on the bounce to deep midwicket
Wide on a length, cut to backward point. Touch slower there, might've turned away a touch
Flat again, around off, Dube whips it off the inner-half of the bat to deep midwicket
Full around off, whipped to long-on
Uppish cut, on the bounce to backward point. A bit of extra bounce on the legbreak that landed on a length just outside off. Shankar rose with the bounce and went hard at it
Fullish on leg, very flat, flicked to long-on
Dube won't attack him first ball this over. Length on leg, flicked towards square leg.
Shortish ball is wide and Dube flashes at it, connects decently, deep point races to the left to slide and cut it off
Yorker missed. Shin-high full toss is flicked to deep-backward square leg
No. Touch back of length at best, angling away outside off, steered comfortably to deep-backward point's right
Full just outside off, Dube treats it like it's shortish though. Slaps it with a diagonal bat to cover
Flaps the length ball on fifth to cover point
Short right away, around chest-height just outside off. Bunted with an open-faced bat to point
Pops up again, but too far to the right of the bowler. Was a fullish ball at the stumps that Shankar tried to flick, onto it too early. Pitch has likely slowed down. Was another googly, replay shows
Fullish on leg, flicked softly towards square leg
Shortish and flat, cut well... and cover point isn't able to cut it off. He ran right and flung himself but wasn't in reach

Another leading edge, this time it's taken at cover. Googly at 89ks landed in line with leg stump and turned a touch, Conway tried to chip the ball over midwicket, played in front of the body. Went right up. CSK lose three in the powerplay
Length on leg, flicked to the left of square leg. Likely to have been a legbreak again, no turn this time though
Short, sits up and that's cut with the spin. There was extra cover and cover point, they've been bisected with ease
Shortish on fifth, Shankar walks down and pats it with an open-faced bat, from around rib-height, to point
Bouncer is above head. Good pace off the pitch though. Line was just outside off and Shankar shaped to ramp it over the keeper before pulling out
Quick running to turn it to two. JFM was the fielder running to his right from deep square leg. Good throw to Rahul, but Shankar hared through. Was a length ball that was flicked late
Slower bouncer just outside off, pulled to deep midwicket. Pace not shown, but it looked slow

Run-out chance, Vipraj doesn't get the direct hit from midwicket. Shankar, who ran halfway down, had given up. Was a length ball that he punched off the inside-half of the full-faced bat and took off.
Goes for the pull, doesn't middle it. Ball goes to square leg
Lucky four to the right of short fine leg. Conway looked like he'd attack that ball no matter what. Stood leg side of the length ball and had a hearty swipe, tried to go over square leg
Mukesh is convinced Conway's lbw but that looked down leg. The full ball angled in from around the wicket and beat the flick before deflecting towards point
Works the length ball to deep square leg
Dances down to a length ball around off, turns it into a fullish one and pushes it with an open-faced bat to point
Length around off, 138ks, worked to the leg side
Length around off, defended to point
Walks towards the length ball around fourth, defends it to the bowler's right
Fullish at the stumps, worked to the leg side

Did Shankar nick it? Else that's lbw. Chat among the fielders, Porel thinks he's hit it. From the replay, it looks like the inswinging yorker hit the boot first and then the toe edge as Shankar tried to flick the ball to the leg side. Ultra-Edge confirms it was shoe first, Starc sees the replay and resigns with laughter. Hawk-Eye confirms ball would go on to hit the base of middle
Inswinger almost knocks off stump. Full and fast, 144ks, starts like a fifth-stump ball but curves in late and fast. Shankar tries to drive it down the ground

Gaikwad falls into the trap. JFM was stationed at deep-backward square leg and has to move to the right to take it comfortably. Was a 141ks ball around a back of a length after a few full balls. Gaikwad tried to help it along the way with a one-legged flick, timed it nicely but hit it flat and misplaced it.
Overpitched, swinging in a touch towards fourth, Gaikwad lunges and nails another check drive but finds cover
Fullish again, down leg. Past the attempted flick
Glorious extra-cover drive, it's with a check and a slightly open-faced bat. The stride across to the fullish 141ks ball angling away from him was small but confident
Length ball at 135ks is around top of middle, flicked towards the edge of the ring at midwicket

Leading edge back to the bowler, is that a result of the two-paced nature of the pitch? 133ks length ball at the hip, Ravindra tried to flick it through midwicket while standing upright. Was into the shot too early, the ball lobbed softly, low to Mukesh's right. He had time to stop himself almost completely to get down and take it.
Bouncer is very short, lands around leg stump and goes through fourth stump. Ravindra sways out of the way. 132ks
Fullish on the pads, beaten on the flick. Ball rolls off the pad towards midwicket

Misfield at point allows an extra run, Vipraj swooped in and tried to pick up and throw with the right hand. Laid no hand on it. Was an inswinging length ball around fourth that Conway pushed with a fully open bat face despite having little room
Shortish ball at the hips is pulled to long leg
Full ball slants onto the pads, 141ks, so Conway not connecting with the flick didn't matter. The ball raced off the pad, too fine for deep fine leg to be in picture
Inside edges a straight drive onto pad, ball deflects along the ground to cover. Was a 144ks full ball angling in towards off
Fullish on leg, clipped to the left of Mukesh at square leg. He lays fingertips and takes the pace off the ball as it rolls into the outfield
Wide on a length, guided to deep point

Starc gets away with it. A bouncer just under the shoulder was angling slightly down leg, Conway tried to use the pace and angle but the bottom hand came off as he pulled. Fielder half-stops it, parries it to the side.
Dabs it off the middle this time, a firmer square drive this time. Gets it wide of slips... and the klaxon goes off. Starc has overstepped

A bit of swing away early to beat the dangling bat. Length ball lands around fourth stump and keeps going away, Ravindra didn't transfer his weight, tried to run it to third with the bat-face facing extra cover. Very tentative.
